name: sflens
description: A local-first Salesforce debug log explorer and MCP debugging interface

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sflens/core && npm run build -w @sflens/bridge && npm run build -w @sflens/mcp && npm run build -w @sflens/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @sflens/core && npm run test -w @sflens/bridge && npm run test -w @sflens/web && npm run test:relay
